title: Fred Darwin's list of a high-level flying saucer committee

tellings.quote: Darwin listed these names as involved in a special committee on flying [music] saucers at the highest level.

plain: A man named Fred Darwin wrote down a list of names, saying these men sat on a special committee on flying saucers at the highest level of the US defense research world in the late 1940s and early 1950s. Jesse Michels tells this himself, and the names he cites include the engineer Vannevar Bush and the mathematician John von Neumann. If true, it would mean top American scientists were quietly studying flying saucers.
